episode_title: Ep 224 - "I Am the Voice, with Jared Thayer"

real_qa.q: How did Jared Thayer transition from low-wage construction work to founding a profitable contracting business?
real_qa.r: Jared Thayer went from earning $20 an hour in various construction roles to getting his contractor's license and charging $45 an hour as a handyman for a property management company. When that relationship ended and revenue dropped from $90K to zero overnight, he returned to learning, searched online for how to run a successful construction company, talked to mentors, and began serving homeowners directly through door knocking, flyers, and local lead generation services. He progressed from $45 gutter cleaning jobs to $450 dry rot repairs to eventually $150,000 basement remodels by adding in-house design capabilities around 2019-2020.
real_qa.requete: Jared Thayer construction business growth strategy

real_qa.q: What key business decision did Jared Thayer make that changed FAIR Design Build's sophistication and pricing power?
real_qa.r: Jared brought in-house design capabilities around 2019-2020, which was a real game changer. He found that adding professional renderings and a dedicated designer allowed his team to serve a different caliber of homeowner willing to pay more for the predictability of understanding exactly what they would receive and the exceptional service experience. This shift from simple scope-of-work documents to full design renderings elevated the company's level of sophistication and attracted clients with higher budgets.
real_qa.requete: FAIR Design Build design renderings business strategy

real_qa.q: How does Jared Thayer use ChatGPT and AI to teach his sons business and character lessons?
real_qa.r: During his divorce, when behavioral issues arose, Jared would ask ChatGPT to write personalized bedtime stories featuring his three sons—Solomon, Eamon, and Koba—in scenarios like building factories that create tanks. These stories allowed them to visualize themselves working together to create a business and taught lessons about collaboration, building, and shared goals. He describes this intentional approach as attempting to brainwash his children in the best of ways—to be great people, successful, do right and honorable things, study, learn, grow, and build strong family relationships.
real_qa.requete: ChatGPT bedtime stories teach business lessons children

real_qa.q: What is Jared Thayer's approach to work-life integration versus work-life balance as a single father?
real_qa.r: Jared shifted from viewing work and parenting as separate—what he calls work-life balance—to work-life integration. He now brings his kids to the office, works from home, and aims to make both succeeding in business and raising great children a priority, with children taking precedence if the two conflict. He also deliberately exposes his sons to adult business concepts, finances, and decision-making rather than hiding these topics, believing this prepares them to make informed choices about their own futures.
real_qa.requete: work-life integration single father business entrepreneurship

real_qa.q: Why does Jared Thayer regret naming his construction company after his last name?
real_qa.r: Jared regrets naming his company Thayer Construction because it ties the business identity to his personal identity, which makes it more difficult to sell the business if he chooses to do so in the future. He notes that while many respectable companies successfully use the owner's last name, this naming convention created a challenge for him regarding business valuation and transferability.
real_qa.requete: naming business after owner last name disadvantages

real_qa.q: What does Jared Thayer identify as his core values and how do they shape his business decisions?
real_qa.r: Jared's core values, in order of priority, are: his health, his relationships with his three children, and his career mission. He views having a business as giving him the freedom to make his own rules and prioritize these values—turning down opportunities that conflict with school activities and time with his sons. He explicitly states he does not want to become a multimillionaire while failing to raise great kids, and he uses these values as a guardrail for business decisions.
real_qa.requete: Jared Thayer core values health children business priority

guest.bio_context: Jared Thayer is a 37-year-old entrepreneur who overcame a difficult childhood marked by parental divorce and his mother's substance abuse issues. He transitioned from construction work and various labor jobs into founding Thayer Construction in 2014, two months before his marriage, which he grew into FAIR Design Build—a remodeling company with 10 team members specializing in design-build services for homeowners. He is currently a single father of three sons and intentionally integrates work-life integration to prioritize both his children's upbringing and business growth.
